records.source: The table it measures is a SNAPSHOT taken above, not the widget's live model. A measure run takes minutes and preparing the next batch while it runs is the natural thing to do, so the GUI thread can append rows and delete channel and mask keys underneath this -- which reaches the worker as a ``KeyError`` in the middle of writing, or as half a field that nobody asked for. The snapshot is plain data, so copying it is cheap and it cannot be edited from anywhere.
records.context: The table it measures is a SNAPSHOT taken above, not the widget's live model. A measure run takes minutes and preparing the next batch while it executes is the natural thing to do, so the main GUI execution path can append rows and delete image data channel and mask structured-data names underneath this -- which reaches the worker as a ``KeyError`` in the middle of writing, or as half a microscope field of view that nobody asked for. The snapshot is plain data, so copying it is cheap and it cannot be edited from anywhere.
records.translation: Die gemessene Tabelle ist ein oben erstellter SCHNAPPSCHUSS, nicht das Live-Modell des Widgets. Ein Messlauf dauert Minuten, und während er läuft den nächsten Stapel vorzubereiten ist naheliegend, sodass der GUI-Thread darunter Zeilen anhängen und Kanal- und Maskenschlüssel löschen kann -- was beim Worker mitten im Schreiben als ``KeyError`` ankommt oder als halbes Feld, das niemand angefordert hat. Der Schnappschuss besteht aus einfachen Daten, daher ist das Kopieren billig, und er kann von nirgendwo bearbeitet werden.
records.review_basis: Independent AI technical review against the English source; no native-speaker signoff.
